sections.E: 弱化动词与判断词系统

discipline: 从语料库取句式必须结合本稿数据与文献，不得复制无关实例数字
写结论句前先定证据等级（自有测量=强 / 转述他人=中 / 推断=弱）再选动词
引用他人数字一律用 as reported by the source studies，不写 we found
缺失信息保留 [占位]，不编造
句式模板可复用，实例细节必须改写；禁止整句照搬

entries.group: A1 背景铺陈（现状陈述）
entries.label: 现状+任务列举
entries.template: [Agent] now handle tasks that were, until recently, firmly in the hands of human operators: [V-ing 列举 3-4 项]
entries.example: "Autonomous agents built on large language models now handle tasks that were, until recently, firmly in the hands of human operators: writing code across a repository, navigating a browser to complete a purchase, running a data-analysis pipeline, or drafting a research report."（§1 P1）

entries.group: A1 背景铺陈（现状陈述）
entries.label: 趋势短句
entries.template: The trajectory has been steep.

entries.group: A1 背景铺陈（现状陈述）
entries.label: 领域动态
entries.template: Dozens of [surveys] now map the design space of these systems, and the number of [primary studies] grows by the month.

entries.group: A1 背景铺陈（现状陈述）
entries.label: 具体数据锚点
entries.template: [X], one of the earliest [Y], had accumulated more than [N] [metric] by the time of our data collection in [Month Year].
entries.example: "AutoGPT ... had accumulated more than 187,000 GitHub stars by the time of our data collection in October 2026"（§1 P1）

entries.group: A2 研究空白（核心句式）
entries.label: 差距陈述
entries.template: The [X] side of the field has not kept pace.
entries.example: "The evaluation side of the field has not kept pace."（§1 P2）

entries.group: A2 研究空白（核心句式）
entries.label: 综述对比+空白
entries.template: Existing surveys of [topic] concentrate on [A] [ref], on [B] [ref], or on [C] [ref]. What is missing is a systematic account of *how* [the literature] actually [V]s — [列举被忽视维度].

entries.group: A2 研究空白（核心句式）
entries.label: 空白后果
entries.template: Without such an account, claims such as "[claim]" rest on uneven ground, and [journals] have no shared benchmark against which to judge a submission.

entries.group: A2 研究空白（核心句式）
entries.label: 继承问题
entries.template: [Field] inherits these problems and adds new ones: [V-ing 三项并列].
entries.example: "Agent research inherits these problems and adds new ones: agents are stochastic in ways that are hard to bound, ..."（§1 P2）

entries.label: 问题列表
entries.template: We therefore ask three research questions: + 编号 **RQ1 (标签).** How do [对象] report [维度], and how has this changed between [Year1] and [Year2]?

entries.label: 问题即承诺
entries.template: 每个 RQ 用 (标签) 括注维度名，问题本身是疑问句

entries.label: 三分贡献
entries.template: Our contribution is threefold. We provide [A]; we contribute [B]; and we synthesize [C].

entries.label: 创新定位
entries.template: — a focus we are not aware of in prior surveys, which have concentrated on [X] and [Y]

entries.label: 谦逊+可信度
entries.template: We do not claim that our corpus is exhaustive — the field moves too quickly for that — but the protocol is fully described and the data are re-collectable, which is the point.

entries.label: 章节预告
entries.template: The rest of the paper is organised as follows. Section 2 [功能]. Section 3 [功能]. Section 4 reports the results for each research question. Section 5 [功能]. Section 6 concludes.

entries.label: 协议声明
entries.template: We followed a protocol adapted from [标准实践], simplified for a fast-moving field where [标准做法] is impractical but transparency remains achievable.

entries.label: 步骤枚举
entries.template: The protocol has four steps: (i) [search], (ii) [eligibility], (iii) [coding], (iv) [synthesis].

entries.label: 纳入标准
entries.template: A study was eligible if (a) ..., (b) ..., (c) ..., and (d) ...

entries.label: 排除说明
entries.template: We excluded [X], [Y], and [Z].

entries.label: 不设限理由
entries.template: We did not restrict by venue, because restricting to [high-impact venues] would have biased the sample towards [the very norms we wished to assess].

entries.label: 采集声明
entries.template: We collected [data] for [N] [对象] directly from [source] on [date].

entries.label: 选择标准
entries.template: We chose [对象] that (a) ..., (b) ..., and (c) ...

entries.label: 局限自陈
entries.template: Because of [限制], our single-date snapshot is a point estimate, not a trend; the collection script is provided so the snapshot can be re-taken.

entries.label: 未测不报
entries.template: The resulting [计数] could not be reliably re-verified at revision time. We therefore do not report a specific figure and rely on the [替代证据] below.

entries.label: 可验证边界
entries.template: We were transparent with ourselves about what can and cannot be verified from the materials available to us.

entries.label: 双级编码
entries.template: We distinguish two coding levels and only claim the second one.

entries.label: 拒编造声明
entries.template: We explicitly do not claim to have audited full texts for [X], because doing so without the full texts would be fabrication.

entries.label: 二次数据纪律
entries.template: All benchmark numbers cited in [section] are secondary data taken from the cited primary studies; we did not re-run any benchmark. In line with the reporting discipline for secondary data, we describe these numbers as reported by the source studies rather than as our own measurements. Where a number is a statistic we computed ourselves (e.g., ...), we say so explicitly.

entries.group: B5 AI 使用声明（投稿必用句式）
entries.label: AI 辅助写作声明
entries.template: The authors used an LLM-based writing assistant to help draft and copy-edit parts of the text for readability and style. The study design, data collection, coding, and analysis were carried out by the authors; the assistant was not used to generate results, select sources, or formulate conclusions. All authors reviewed and take responsibility for the final content.

entries.label: 分布特征
entries.template: The distribution is strongly concentrated at the top.

entries.label: 占比表述
entries.template: The [top-N] repositories ... account for [X] of the [Y] total [metric], roughly half ([N]%).

entries.label: 范围表述
entries.template: [指标] reported in the corpus ranged from [最小值描述] ... to [最大值描述] ...

entries.label: 单例锚定
entries.template: (e.g., [18] with three frontier models; [9] with ten backbones; ...)

entries.label: 多源收敛
entries.template: [N] independent [studies], published between [Y1] and [Y2], converge on the same picture.

entries.label: 跨组收敛
entries.template: These three studies, from different groups and years, converge on the same conclusion: [结论].

entries.label: 显著特征
entries.template: The striking feature of this synthesis is the absence of [X].

entries.label: 证据综合
entries.template: Taken together, these results establish that [结论], and that [补充结论].

entries.label: 最强结论
entries.template: This is, in our view, the most actionable finding of [RQ]: [结论].

entries.group: C3 未测量说明（关键纪律）
entries.label: 不可得则止
entries.template: Whether [X] is reported cannot be established from [source]; based on [evidence], it is unlikely to be [V], but we refrain from asserting a specific figure we did not measure.

entries.group: C3 未测量说明（关键纪律）
entries.label: 明示待审
entries.template: We note this explicitly because it is the central [question] for the field, and it deserves a dedicated full-text audit in future work.

entries.label: 三分含义
entries.template: Three implications follow from our results. First, ... Second, ... Third, ...

entries.label: 否定式强化
entries.template: The [X] documented in [section] is not merely a matter of style.

entries.label: 机理链
entries.template: When [X], a difference between [A] and [B] cannot be distinguished from [噪声], and the literature accumulates claims that later work quietly fails to reproduce.

entries.label: 建议引入
entries.template: Based on [证据] and the [结果], we propose a short checklist for [对象]. It is deliberately minimal; we intend it as a floor, not a ceiling.

entries.label: 不越界建议
entries.template: We deliberately avoid prescribing a specific [标准], because the evidence base is not yet mature enough for a single standard; we recommend, instead, that [期刊/作者] [动作].

entries.label: 清单条目
entries.template: **N. [动宾短语].** [一句说明 + 证据引用 [ref]].

entries.label: 直陈局限
entries.template: Our review has limitations that we state plainly. First, ... Second, ... Third, ... Fourth, ... Fifth, ...

entries.label: 稳健性论证
entries.template: None of these limitations changes the main conclusions, which are negative in character and therefore robust to [corpus expansion]: [三点并列].

entries.label: 手动判断透明
entries.template: the mapping between [X] was done by hand and is reported in [附录] so that readers can disagree with it.

entries.label: 双希望式
entries.template: We hope [A] is adopted by [对象] as a [要求], and we hope the next generation of [X] [动词]s [实践] rather than merely [编目架构].

entries.label: 里程碑式收束
entries.template: The field will know its [X] are maturing when its [Y] become as reproducible as its [Z].

entries.label: 等级
entries.template: 动词

entries.label: 强（自有测量）
entries.template: collected / account for / show

entries.label: 中（转述他人）
entries.template: found that / reported that / showed that / demonstrated that / noted that / argued that / proposed / introduced / described / catalogued / surveyed / distilled / observed

entries.label: 弱（推断/未测）
entries.template: is unlikely to be / appears to / seems to / we refrain from asserting / we do not claim / we explicitly do not claim

entries.label: bullet
entries.template: 禁用绝对化副词：proves / clearly / definitely / obviously / certainly（本稿零出现）

entries.label: bullet
entries.template: 允许的强限定：`Taken together, ... establish that ...`（仅当多源证据支持时）

entries.label: bullet
entries.template: 常用软限定：`roughly` / `about` / `approximately` / `in relative terms` / `partly because` / `more concerningly`

entries.label: bullet
entries.template: **本地补记 · JARVIS 2026-10-13（对抗测试后追加，非原文）**：本节原先只收**副词**。用一份故意写满绝对化断言的样稿做对抗测试后，**13 处违规只被抓到 7 处**，漏掉的全是**绝对化动词 / 断言式短语 / 最高级**。⇒ 纪律扩展为「**按绝对化强度收，不按词性收**」，补入：

entries.label: bullet
entries.template: 绝对化动词/短语：`definitively` · `completely eliminates` · `fully eliminates` · `eliminates the problem` · `fully understood` · `guaranteed` / `is guaranteed`

entries.label: bullet
entries.template: 断言式短语：`well known` / `it is well known` · `no other explanation` · `in all cases` · `under all conditions`

entries.label: bullet
entries.template: 最高级：`best available` · `the best possible`

entries.label: bullet
entries.template: **实现同源**：`_phrase-lint.py` 的 `BOOSTERS` 表；并已为该扩展配**必失败夹具**（新词必须真被检测路径命中，否则是假绿）。
